guide.title: Tips for more natural speech
guide.intro: A few small checks help before you create speech.
guide.tipNumbers: Write numbers, dates, and units the way you want them spoken aloud.
guide.tipAbbreviations: Avoid ambiguous abbreviations and use commas to create a short pause.
support.title: Support the Project & Usage Limits
support.whyLimitsDesc: All Voice provides free AI text-to-speech synthesis and speech recognition with the following standard usage guidelines:
support.limitsRule1: Under 2,000 characters: Instant generation in 1–3 seconds, ideal for short clips and dialogues.
support.limitsRule2: 2,000 - 20,000 characters: Automatic chunked streaming for smooth playback.
support.limitsRule3: 20,000 characters ceiling: Ensures fair queuing and quick response times for everyone.
support.donateDesc: Scan VietQR or support via Buy Me a Coffee to help keep the service free for the community.
support.qrPlaceholder: Scan VietQR to support All Voice server hosting
support.serverSpecDesc: Use proper punctuation (commas, periods) to let the AI create natural pauses; expand ambiguous abbreviations.
support.selfHostDesc: All Voice is completely open source. You can download the source code and run it locally on your own machine.
